segments.name: Advertising
segments.description: Provides AI-powered advertising solutions for advertisers and publishers to reach audiences, monetize inventory, and measure marketing performance.
segments.evidence: We provide end-to-end artificial intelligence-powered ("AI") advertising solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audience.

revenueModel.text: Advertisers pay dynamically based on campaign goals, publishers pay percentage of spend or usage-based fees, and SaaS subscription fees from measurement platform users.
revenueModel.evidence: We primarily generate revenue from fees paid by advertisers who use our advertising solutions to grow and monetize their content.

changes.text: In 2025, the company divested its Apps business and now operates as a single reportable segment, previously operating multiple segments.
changes.evidence: Following the sale of the Apps business, we operate as a single operating and reportable segment.
